The% of training provided to men is 275/1020 = 26.9%

column7: Gap (in %) between training hours attended by men and followed by women
column8: "Example calculation for the expected result: The company has 2000 employees; including 49% (980) of women and 51% (1020) of men. The company delivered 500 hours of training; 45% (225) to women and 55% (275) to men. We divide 980/225 to find the number of hours of training on average for women: 4.35 We divide 1020/275 to find the average number of training hours for men: 3.7 Or a total of the average training hours equal to 3.7 + 4.35 = 8.05 To obtain the training effort in hours for women, we calculate 4.35 / 8.05 x 100 = 54% To obtain the training effort in hours for men, we calculate 3.7 / 8.05 x 100 = 46% We therefore obtain: 46 (M) - 54 (F) = - 8% "
